description: Free, no key: the summary of a borrow, a deposit or a Multiply before building it: amount received, LTV, max LTV, liquidation price, rate, Trnch fee, leverage and price impact. action borrow { marketId, amount (USDG to receive) or ltv:20|35|50|max, collateral }, deposit { marketId, amount }, multiply { marketId, collateral, leverage 1.2 to max }. Nothing to sign.

amount.description: borrow: USDG to receive, or ltv:20|35|50|max; deposit: USDG to lend.

collateral.description: Collateral supplied with the borrow or the Multiply, in collateral units (0 for none on a borrow).

leverage.description: multiply: target leverage, 1.2 up to the Trnch cap (x2 on Stock Tokens), or max.
